attempted_axis: EXTERN-RETYPE lane TU pass over game/shop/shop.c: retype the untyped shadowing `extern u8 gPlayers[]` and `extern u8* gCurLevel` to the typed header declarations, promote the sites those retypes give authority over, and adopt the Xbox PDB `shop_item` field names into the TU's pre-existing DSItem view.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.local-alias-vs-direct-global-spelling-diverges APPLIED: every one of the 12 gPlayers sites kept its EXISTING base spelling through the retype (mechanical `(u8*)` cast, or `&arr[expr]` -> `(u8*)arr + expr` where the array element type changed), nothing was unified onto a canonical form, and each step was gated against the whole 14-function TU. claim.law.swap-loop-is-record-layout-ground-truth APPLIED as the verification instrument: ShopLoadData's own byte-swap loop proved the shop_item layout before any name was adopted. claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing screened: fn_8009A0AC's `lvl` is a plain global-pointer copy, NOT a walked or index-computed base, so the law's hazard does not reach it -- the typed `level_data* lvl` was A/B'd anyway and gated byte-identical across all 3 field reads. claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade APPLIED and honored: this law's own evidence is shop.c, so no new aggregate member was added to any shared header; DSItem stayed a file-local typedef and only its field IDENTIFIERS changed, with every declared width left exactly as the prior reconstruction had it. claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction screened: the 13148 and 80 strides were left as bare literals. claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web screened: the 34 existing DSItem offsetof sites were already in that form and only had their member identifier renamed.
attributes.residual: The 56 remaining bare sites were deliberately NOT forced, per this lane's scope: they are the per-player draw-layout scratch cluster the TU's own header comment already defers (`slot` 7, `dpage`, `playerBlits`, `playerPad`), plus a blit-entry record `e` (4), a menu/draw `item` base past the shop_item record's 0x50 end (2), and `clsBase + 144` (1). None of them gains authority from a gPlayers or gCurLevel retype, which is what this lane was scoped to unblock. do_shop, shop_setup, do_shopping_8009AA48 and write_shop_menu are all recorded caps and were treated as byte-gate-only: the retype respellings that pass through them gated byte-identical and nothing else was attempted there.
attributes.scope: src/game/shop/shop.c only. Two gated commits. `extern u8 gPlayers[]` -> `Player gPlayers[4]` (12 sites respelled, `player = (Player*)gPlayers` collapsing to `player = gPlayers`); `extern u8* gCurLevel` -> `level_data*` with fn_8009A0AC's `lvl` promoted to a typed `level_data*` and its 3 shop_max* reads becoming member access. DSItem field names adopted from the Xbox PDB `shop_item` (misc.h Id=3505, Size=0x50): _pad->blit, field_20->desc, field_40->scale, field_44->type, field_4C->amount, across 34 sites. Bare-site debt unchanged at 56 by design.
